cards.task: Use the key to open the door, then reach the goal.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the door, then never reaches the goal.

cards.notes: Task text: first task of examples/arm-fm/minigrid-doorkey/tasks.json. Pilot bundle generated from this text. Changed in card fix 2: the key-before-door and door-before-goal orders are forced by the world, so they are optional extras in scoring (`forced`); Existence(at_goal) alone is also a correct output.

cards.task: Acquire the matching key, unlock the door, and pick up the designated box in the other room.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the door, then never picks up the box.

cards.notes: Task text: first task of examples/arm-fm/minigrid-unlock-pickup/tasks.json. Pilot bundle generated from this text. The agent carries one object, so it drops the key before taking the box. Changed in card fix 2: the key-before-door and door-before-box orders are forced by the world, so they are optional extras in scoring (`forced`); Existence(target_picked_up) alone is also a correct output.

cards.task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

wrong.why: Clears the ball, takes the key and opens the door, then never picks up the box.

cards.notes: Task text: first task of examples/arm-fm/minigrid-blocked-unlock-pickup/tasks.json. The first drop must leave the door reachable. Changed in card fix 2: the wording now says the ball and the key may come in either order (the example task text keeps the ball-first list), because a key-first run satisfies every clause; the three orders are forced by the world, so they are optional extras in scoring (`forced`) and Existence(target_picked_up) alone is also a correct output.

cards.task: Explore the side rooms, find and acquire the key matching the locked target room, return to the corridor, open the target door, and pick up the designated object.

wrong.why: Takes the key and opens the target door, then never picks up the object.

cards.notes: Task text: first task of examples/arm-fm/minigrid-key-corridor/tasks.json. Navigation opens closed unlocked side doors on the way. Changed in card fix 2: the key-before-door and door-before-object orders are forced by the world, so they are optional extras in scoring (`forced`); Existence(target_picked_up) alone is also a correct output, and the card does not measure exploration.
